qa: Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving. This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ [All Turns] When any of your other Digimon with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by returning this Digimon to the hand, they don't leave.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, gain 1 memory.
